id.description: Unique, immutable identifier of the filter.

label.description: Mutable display name of the filter.

iconUrl.description: Optional icon shown alongside the filter in the UI.

sourceDataset.description: The source dataset this filter applies to. Cannot be changed after creation.

pipeline.description: OPAL pipeline expression defining the filter predicate. Observations matching the pipeline are candidates for dropping, subject to `dropRate`.

layout.description: Reserved for UI state. Stored and returned verbatim, never interpreted by Observe. Safe to omit.

dropRate.description: Fraction (0.0-1.0) of matching observations to drop. 1.0 = drop all matches; 0.0 = drop none.

enabled.description: Whether the filter is actively dropping observations. Disabled filters are retained but have no effect on ingest.

managedBy.description: Identifies the owner/manager of this filter. Managed filters cannot be modified through the API.

updatedBy.description: User who most recently updated the filter.

updatedAt.description: When the filter was last updated.

DatasetBrief.title: DatasetBrief
DatasetBrief.description: Brief record fields for a DatasetRef (label, description, iconUrl, contentType). Field naming mirrors ObjectBrief in this same file (iconUrl, not icon) for consistency across reference-brief pairs.

contentType.description:
The type of data the referenced dataset contains — Resource, Log,
Metric, OTelSpan, OTelTrace, or Unknown. Derived from the dataset's
kind and interface bindings.

DatasetContentType.title: DatasetContentType
DatasetContentType.description:
The type of data a dataset contains. For Resource datasets, this is
determined by the dataset kind. For other kinds, it is derived from the
dataset's interface bindings. Returns Unknown if no recognized interface
is found.

DatasetRef.title: DatasetRef
DatasetRef.description: A reference to a dataset. Always carries the id; the optional `record` field carries the brief metadata, populated when expand=true. Mirrors ObjectRef (see ObjectRef / ObjectBrief in this file).

ObjectBrief.title: ObjectBrief
ObjectBrief.description: Brief record fields for an ObjectRef. This type is polymorphic: additional fields pointing to specific object types (e.g. dataset, dashboard, monitor) may be added in the future as needed.

managedBy.description: Owner/manager of this object. Always returned as an id-only ObjectRef even when the parent was requested with expand=true: `expand` populates a single layer of brief data, so `record.managedBy` on a brief is itself never expanded. Pass the inner id back through a separate request (or filter via CEL, which lazily resolves) to access the manager's brief.

ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef
ObjectRef.description: A reference to another resource. Always carries the id; the optional `record` field carries the brief metadata, populated when expand=true. Brief expansion applies to one layer only — fields inside `record` that are themselves ObjectRefs (e.g. `record.managedBy`) are returned id-only, never with their own `record` populated. CEL filter expressions can deeper-resolve via lazy wrapper resolution if needed.
